body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38104
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/815

## Summary

Reproduced both reported precedence failures through the checked-out Chat Completions conversion path and captured the kwargs received by apply_chat_template. An explicit request effort now wins over the server default whether supplied as the top-level reasoning_effort field or in chat_template_kwargs. Silent requests still receive the server default, unrelated template defaults still merge, and the Responses API retains its separately pinned behavior.

The implementation records explicit Chat Completions intent before normalization pops reasoning_effort from chat_template_kwargs, then skips only the conflicting server-default key. Other _process_messages callers use the existing default behavior.

## Reproduction and validation

Before the fix, the focused regression produced two failures: both explicit xhigh forms rendered as medium. After the fix:

- Focused regression and boundary set: 5 passed, 2 subtests passed.
- Responses API precedence boundary: 1 passed.
- Full affected unit files: 173 passed, 70 subtests passed.
- Pre-commit checks on all changed source, test, and docs files: passed.

Commands and raw outputs are retained under reports/j-5043561b3d80, with structured claims in result.json.

## Limitations

The reported Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 weights and 2x NVIDIA H200 NVL TP2+EP2 environment were unavailable. I did not claim a full-model reasoning-length or multi-GPU reproduction. This deterministic defect occurs before engine execution, so the assigned gfx950 was not used; the regression verifies the actual template-render inputs rather than model semantic accuracy.
title: Fix Chat Completions reasoning effort precedence
